Bido Product Guide - Foreplay in a bottle!

 

This detailed product guide has been designed to provide you with comprehensive information on bido's unique features, benefits, and ingredients. Use this guide to educate and inspire your audience, while showcasing bido's holistic approach to sexual health and well-being.

 

I. bido at a glance

 

·      Premium sexual health dietary supplement in a convenient 2.5 fl oz shot

·      Made with a blend of natural herbs, adaptogens, vitamins, and amino acids

·      Formulated to support libido (sex drive), reduce stress, improve blood flow, and promote overall well-being

·      Holistic approach to sexual health, focusing on physical, emotional, mental, and social aspects

·      Manufactured in a FDA registered, cGMP certified, and allergen-free facility in the United States

 

Our mission is to empower individuals to embrace their sexuality and cultivate healthy relationships through self-care, open communication, and holistic well-being.

 

Furthermore, we are committed to breaking down the barriers of traditional thinking and destigmatizing the sexual wellness space.

 

We believe in the importance of sexual health as a key component of overall well-being, and we seek to encourage acceptance, understanding, and self-discovery in this important aspect of human life.

 

 

II. Unique Features

 

1)    Convenience:

·      Easy-to-consume, single-serve liquid shots for on-the-go convenience

·      Easy to incorporate into routines, either as a quick boost or a long-term lifestyle choice

·      No need for pills, patches, drops, or powders

·      Can be enjoyed anytime, anywhere, and in a social setting without stigma. Sharing a drink together not only enhances the moment but also adds a sociable and enjoyable touch to the experience.

·      Best enjoyed chilled, but no refrigeration necessary

 

2)    Tailored Formulas:

·      Tailored formulas for her (Pomegranate) and for him (Berry Ginger)

·      Some ingredients exclusive to each formula to better serve and boost specific benefits

·      Safe for everyone to consume either version, regardless of gender identity or background

 

At bido, we believe in the power of inclusivity and recognize the distinct qualities that set each of us apart. We understand that everyone's journey is different, and that's why our ingredients are safe for anyone to consume, regardless of their gender identity or background. We encourage everyone to learn more about the benefits of our ingredients and choose the formula that best suits their needs today. bido is more than just a libido supplement; it's a social lubricant meant to open the lines of communication around healthy sex and make difficult conversations less intimidating.

 

3)    Transparency and Quality:

·      No hidden or unknown amounts of prescription medication

·      Made with high-quality, carefully selected ingredients

·      Produced in a facility that adheres to Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)

 

 

III. Key Benefits

 

·      Reduces stress

·      Elevates mood

·      Increases vitality

·      Improves circulation

·      Boosts immunity

·      Boosts libido

 

 

IV. Ingredients Highlights

 

We have carefully selected each of our ingredients based on traditional use and preliminary research. Our goal is to provide our customers with a product that supports sexual health and overall well-being.

1)    Core Ingredients (included in both versions):

·      Maca: boosts energy, vitality and libido for an active lifestyle

·      Ashwagandha KSM-66: relives stress, promoting relaxation for improved sexual health

·      L-Citrulline & L-Arginine: enhances circulation and blood flow, supporting better sexual performance

·      Muira Puama: improves sexual desire and function, leading to more satisfying experiences

·      Panax Ginseng: supports cognitive, nervous system, and sexual performance for overall well-being

·      Ginger: lowers blood pressure and increases blood flow, contributing to a healthy body

·      Ginkgo Biloba: bolsters cognitive support and blood flow, promoting a sharp mind and improved sexual health

·      Vitamin C: strengthens immunity, keeping you healthy and active for better sexual well-being

·      Vitamin B3: addresses vascular conditions, optimizing blood flow for enhanced sexual experiences

 

2)    Ingredients Tailored for Her (included in the “for her” version):

·      Schisandra: balances estrogen and progesterone hormones, boosting energy for a vibrant life

·      Damiana: enhances sexual function and desire specifically by positively influencing estrogen levels, fostering deeper connections

·      Hibiscus Flower: supports mood and hormonal balance by regulating estrogen levels, addressing emotional well-being

3)    Ingredients Tailored for Him (included in the “for him” version):

·      Epimedium (Horny Goat Weed): elevates libido and sexual function by positively influencing testosterone levels

·      Tribulus Terrestris: boosts testosterone levels and sexual function, promoting increased virility

·      Saw Palmetto: promotes prostate health and balances hormone levels, particularly by regulating testosterone and DHT, for overall wellness

 

These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease.

 

Remember, individual results may vary, and it's crucial to convey this message responsibly and transparently.

 

Use this product guide as a reference to effectively communicate our unique features, benefits, and ingredients.

 

Thank you for you interest in our products, and we look forward to your success in helping others "drink up and get down."
